**Finding: deviation (GOVLAW, medium).**

- **Governing law (§ 11, p0043):** the agreement selects "the laws of the Arizona" — outside our accepted list (NY, DE, CA, England & Wales).
- **Forum (§ 19, p0053/p0056):** all disputes, including pre- and post-contract matters, are funneled into mandatory binding arbitration under U.S. Arbitration & Mediation rules, with no court venue. Not a walk-away (the seat is domestic, not foreign), but it defeats our preferred court-jurisdiction position.

**Redline (validated, preferred level):** Arizona → State of New York; Section 19 retitled "Dispute Resolution"; the arbitration and award-confirmation language replaced with exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County and a venue waiver. Only the jurisdiction and forum words were touched — the definition of "Disputes" and the surrounding structure remain intact. Fallback offered in the comment: Delaware, California, or England and Wales law with the corresponding courts.
